summary.text: Ben Brooks is a Democratic member of the Maryland State Senate from District 10 who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Army veteran and tax preparer, he previously served in the House of Delegates from 2015 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: Brooks was born in Sumter, South Carolina, on April 23, 1950, served in the U.S. Army from 1969 to 1972, and earned a bachelor's degree in accounting from South Carolina State University in 1976.

He worked as a cost accountant for Joseph E. Seagram and Sons from 1978 to 1987, has owned B&R Brooks Professional Tax Service since 1987, and has been president of Brooks Family Investments since 2004.
He served on the Baltimore County Board of License Commissioners from 2011 to 2013.
Brooks served in the House of Delegates from 2015 to 2023, where he sat on the Economic Matters Committee and was Chief Deputy Majority Whip.
He was elected to the Senate in November 2022 and took office on January 11, 2023.
He chairs the Executive Nominations Committee and also serves on the Rules Committee and the Committee on Education, Energy, and the Environment.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on June 23, 2026.
